pages.text: The window up the front has one bar per block of height, lit from the bottom as it fills. The top lit bar breathes while charging and flickers while discharging.

pages.title: Colours
pages.text: The bars and the lamps on the base share colours.$(li)Blue: cold and safe$(li)Amber: warming$(li)Red: final seconds$(li)Grey with an ember: quenched

pages.title: Rings and Pipes
pages.text: Rings float while it holds charge and spin faster with the flow. They wobble as it warms and drop when it quenches.$(br2)Frosted pipes drip as it warms. Dashes along them show the flow.

pages.title: The Controller
pages.text: Use it for charge, flow, Ports and rate, cell and outside temperature, cooler draw and, while warning, the time to quench.
